title: aechmea lutea
intro: Aechmea lutea, commonly known as the gold plume bromeliad, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. The gold plume bromeliad is known for its vibrant yellow inflorescence, which is often used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Aechmea lutea include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, thanks to its therapeutic actions as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
